walls.note: Front: the girl with the two bags and the lettered block (Michelides 03; panorama 02007 shows the statue on the lawn from the west).

items.where: bronze girl about 1.5 m: bobbed hair, belted coat over a pleated skirt, a bag hanging from the lowered right hand and one tucked under the left arm
items.how: builder: figure kit pose with skirt, a coat cylinder over the trunk, collar, hair mass and ear balls, a hanging case and an under-arm case as boxes; no face, coat folds or belt

items.where: block of polished red granite, 0.74 m square and 1.3 m high with a moulded cap, on a bronze foot plate and a low footing
items.how: builder: footing, shaft, cap slab and a bronze plate

items.where: ANNE FRANK and 1929 - 1945 in white capitals on the front of the block
items.how: builder: raised stroke-font capitals and digits (letterBoxes), two lines

walls.note: Side: coat, sleeve and the under-arm bag in profile; plain block face.
Back: plain block face; the girl from behind (Maaike98 photograph shows the shoulders and hair from the rear).

sources.name: Franklin Heijnen, Anne Frank Merwedeplein Amsterdam
